messages.subject: Bug in fitMeasures function
parts: While attempting to examine model fit using blavaan, I kept getting an error message "Error in validate_ll(x) : NAs not allowed in input." when trying to use the fitMeasures function. I have attached my data file and an Rmd. file with two examples to illustrate this bug. If you have further questions or need more examples, please let me know.

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Bug in fitMeasures function
parts:
Ellen,

Thanks for the reproducible example. It looks like this is happening because some rows in your data are missing all the variables in the model. Everything seems to work if you do something like

allmis <- 2:63 # in your data, rows 2-63 are missing everything
fit1_stan <- bsem(model1, data=dat[-allmis,], std.lv=T)

But it is a bug because you shouldn't have to do this manually, and it will be fixed in the next version.

Best,
Ed

Does this mean I need to use a dataset where all participants in the 3rd condition are removed? Otherwise, I have no missing data. Any thoughts?

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: Bug in fitMeasures function
parts:
Alaa,

I am not sure that missing data is the problem here; you could see similar messages due to a non-positive definite covariance matrix during model estimation. It would be helpful if you could send the exact error message, and also code/data if you are able to send it.

Thanks,
Ed
